title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.l. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 524, for approval by the Department od Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the biling months of March, April and May, 1987. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 477.
